texts.preamble: R.Badri Narayanan vs Commissioner Of Food Safety And Drug ... on 9 November, 2021 Author: Krishnan Ramasamy Bench: Krishnan Ramasamy W.P.No.336 In The High Court Of Judicature At Madras Dated 09.11.2021 Coram The Honourable Mr. Justice Krishnan Ramasamy W.P.No.33601 of 2017 and W.M.P.No.37153 of 2017 R.Badri Narayanan ... Petiti ..Vs.. 1.Commissioner of food safety and Drug administration, 5th Floor, Dms Campus, 259, Anna Salai, Teynampet, Chennai 600 006. 2.The Director General of Police, State of Tamil Nadu, No.1, Dr.Radha Krishnan Salai, Mylapore, Chennai 600 005. 3.The Superintendent of Police, Dindigul District, Ring Road, Ezil Nagar, Dindigul. 4.The Deputy Superintendent of Police, Dsp Office, Dindigul. 1 R.Badri Narayanan vs Commissioner Of Food Safety And Drug ... on 9 November, 2021 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/45723152/ 1 https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis W.P.No 5.The Inspector of Police, Town West Police Station, Dindigul. 6.The Inspector of Police, Taluk Police Station, Dindigul. 7.Food Safety and Standard Authority of India, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare Department, Kotla Road, Fda Bhavan, New Delhi 110 002. ... Res Prayer : Writ Petition is filed under Article 226 of Constitution o praying to issue a writ of mandamus, directing the respondents 3 to interfere in carrying of the business by the petitioner within the Cigarette and other Tobacco Products Act, 2003. For Petitioner : Mr.D.Veerasekaran For Respondents : Mr.V.Nanmaran Government Advocate for R1 Order
texts.facts: This writ petition has been filed, praying for issuance of a Writ of Mandamus, to direct the respondents 3 to 6 not to interfere with the business of the petitioner. After filing the writ petition, there was no harassment and the respondents have not been interfering with the business of the petitioner. 3.
texts.arguments: . The learned counsel appearing for the petitioner submits that this writ petition has been filed in the year 2017 since there was harassment by the respondents by interfering with the business activity of the petitioner. Mr.V.Nanmaran, learned Government Advocate appearing for the respondents 1 to 6 submits that the respondents had not committed the offence of harassment even prior to filing of the present Writ Petition as alleged by the petitioner and if at all any such interference was made, it was only in accordance with law.
texts.petitioner_arguments: . The learned counsel appearing for the petitioner submits that this writ petition has been filed in the year 2017 since there was harassment by the respondents by interfering with the business activity of the petitioner. Mr.V.Nanmaran, learned Government Advocate appearing for the respondents 1 to 6 submits that the respondents had not committed the offence of harassment even prior to filing of the present Writ Petition as alleged by the petitioner and if at all any such interference was made, it was only in accordance with law.
